act: AIFC Authorised Market Institution Rules (AMI), V11

en.title: 'Environmental Instrument Tokens' (AMI 2.6.1(3)) is undefined; the Glossary instead has a second 'Commodity Derivative Token' entry in the E-position
en.summary: AMI 2.6.1(3) requires a direct-access Member whose access is only for "Commodity Derivative Tokens or Environmental Instrument Tokens" to be a Professional Client. "Environmental Instrument Token" is not defined in the Glossary. Glossary V23 has two entries "Commodity Derivative Token" with the same text: one in alphabetical place under C, and a second one directly after "Environmental Instrument". The AFSA online Glossary has the same duplicate. The second entry may have been meant to define "Environmental Instrument Token"; the text does not show this.
en.correction: Please define "Environmental Instrument Token" in the Glossary (for example by relabelling the second "Commodity Derivative Token" entry, with wording set by the AFSA) and remove the duplicate entry.
